# ChatsSync

> ChatsSync is a WhatsApp CRM made in Faisalabad, Pakistan. It connects a business phone number to Meta's official WhatsApp Business API (Cloud API) and gives teams a WhatsApp-style shared inbox, a rule-based (not AI) chatbot builder, bulk campaigns with Meta-approved templates, a template builder, contacts with labels, reports and an Android app with instant notifications. Based in Faisalabad, Pakistan; serves businesses in Pakistan and internationally.

## Key facts
- Website: https://chatssync.online/
- App login: https://app.chatssync.online/app/login
- Contact: WhatsApp / phone +92 322 8413450, email info@chatssync.online
- Location: Faisalabad, Punjab, Pakistan
- Pricing (PKR): 1 Month Rs 5,000; 3 Months Rs 12,500; 1 Year Rs 40,000. Every plan includes every feature and 1 WhatsApp number; additional numbers cost extra (price depends on needs). Meta's WhatsApp template message fees are separate.
- Overview video: https://chatssync.online/assets/chatssync-overview.mp4
- Channels: WhatsApp (official Business API), plus Facebook and Instagram messages in the same inbox.
- Chatbot: rule-based flows (buttons, lists, questions, media, conditions, hand over to human). Not AI.
- Suitable for: e-commerce stores, clinics, real estate, salons, restaurants, schools and academies, travel agents, retail and wholesale businesses in Pakistan.
